name: i18n-tooling
description: Shared product UI i18n pipelines and frontend tooling

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/eslint-plugin-i18n && npm run build --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/i18n-pipeline
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/eslint-plugin-i18n && npm run test --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/i18n-pipeline
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/eslint-plugin-i18n && npm run lint --workspace @redhat-cloud-services/i18n-pipeline
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
